# United Methodist Church of Minot, Maine

> A welcoming United Methodist congregation in rural Minot, Maine, gathering for Sunday worship at 10:00 AM. Motto: "Open Hearts, Open Minds, Open Doors." Methodist worship in Minot dates to the first church built at Minot Corner in 1835.

## Key Facts

- **Name:** United Methodist Church of Minot (Minot UMC)
- **Address:** 142 Minot Ave, Minot, ME 04258, United States
- **Phone:** (207) 783-9097
- **Email:** minotumc@gmail.com
- **Sunday Worship:** 10:00 AM – 11:15 AM, every Sunday
- **Cost:** Free and open to the public; all are welcome
- **Accessibility:** Wheelchair-accessible entrance; children welcome
- **Denomination:** United Methodist Church (UMC)
- **Founded:** First Methodist church at Minot Corner built in 1835; current building traces to an 1859 land deed
- **Motto:** Open Hearts, Open Minds, Open Doors

## What to Expect

Worship blends traditional and contemporary music with meaningful prayer and a short message. Dress is casual — come as you are. Coffee and fellowship follow the service. No prior church experience is needed, and people of all backgrounds are welcome regardless of where they are on their faith journey.

## Pages

- [Home](https://umc-minot-maine.netlify.app/): Welcome, worship times, about, and church history
- [Event Calendar](https://umc-minot-maine.netlify.app/calendar.html): Upcoming worship services, events, and activities
- [Bible Study](https://umc-minot-maine.netlify.app/bible-study.html): Devotionals and study guides for spiritual growth
- [Pastoral Care & Prayer](https://umc-minot-maine.netlify.app/pastoral-care.html): Prayer requests, pastoral support, and the Prayer Wall

## Serving Area

Minot, Auburn, Mechanic Falls, and Poland in Androscoggin County, Maine.
